title: 第5章 你狠我更狠第6章 女人你多冒昧
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
古木城西门外，比起城内冷清的街道，这里稍微热闹了几分。
一片相对开阔的空地上，如同一个临时的集市。
许多风尘仆仆、身上带着血迹和伤痕的冒险者聚集于此。
有的在整理行装，有的则就地摆起了小摊。
“今天刚摘的火荧草，2金币一株！照明、炼金都用得上，量大还能再便宜点！”
“有人收狼牙么？12级狂狼的，品质上乘，带价来别墨迹！”
“让开！快让开！我兄弟腿被毒藤划伤了，需要解毒剂！”
……
吆喝声、伤者的呻吟混杂在一起。
不远处，几名穿着制式铠甲的士兵抱着手臂冷眼旁观。
林默没有多做停留径直向城外走去，与人流逆行。
他的行动立刻吸引了不少目光。
“咦？大半夜的，一个人出城？”
“看他的气息，连10级都不到吧？找死吗？”
“这种菜鸟怕是穷疯了，保不准明天还能再见？”
“再见？你是说他变成野狗屎的样子吧，哈哈哈”
……
议论声传入耳中，林默充耳不闻。
脚步没有丝毫停顿。
然而，他刚踏出城门。

一个身影突然从一旁窜出拦在了他面前。
这人尖嘴猴腮，穿着一身不合身的皮甲，脸上堆着谄媚的笑容凑近：“哟，这位小兄弟，看着面生啊。大半夜一个人出城？要不要来份地图？森林外围的精准地形，标注了低级魔物分布点和几个安全水源，只要10个金币，童叟无欺！”
林默皱了皱眉。
地图他确实需要，但10枚金币，相当于他现有资金的一大半。
这价格简直是抢劫。
他冷淡地回绝：“不需要。”
林默话音刚落，那人脸上的笑容瞬间消失。
变得阴沉而严肃。
他往前逼近一步，压低声音：“小兄弟，我觉得……你需要。”
林默眼神一凝：“什么意思？”
这边的动静也引起了空地上其他冒险者的注意，窃窃私语声传来：“是雷顿，又在坑菜鸟了。”
“这小子倒霉，被雷顿盯上，不死也得脱层皮。”
“是啊，我当初刚来的时候，也被抢过，妈的……”
“嘘，小声点，别惹祸上身。”
……
听着周围的议论，林默心中了然。
他眯起眼睛，看着雷顿：“在城门口打劫？不怕那些守卫么？”
他用眼神示意了一下不远处的士兵。
雷顿嗤笑一声，仿佛听到了天大的笑话，他指了指脚下：“白痴，看清楚，这里已经是城外了！我就算在这里宰了你，那些守卫也顶多过来收个尸，管不着老子发财！”
林默点了点头，脸上看不出什么表情，只是握紧了手中的黑剑。

“原来如此，城外……不受庇护，那我明白了。”
雷顿见他服软，得意地扬了扬下巴：“既然明白了，就别磨蹭了，快把钱……”
content_en:
Outside the west gate of Gumu City, it is a little more lively than the deserted streets in the city.
A relatively open space is like a temporary market.
Many adventurers with bloodstains and scars on their bodies gathered here.
Some are packing their bags, while others have set up stalls on the spot.
"The fireweed we just picked today costs 2 gold coins each! It is useful for lighting and alchemy, and it can be cheaper if the quantity is large!"
"Is anyone buying Wolf Fang? It's a level 12 wolf fang. It's of high quality. Come and leave the ink mark for a price!"
"Get out of the way! Get out of the way! My brother's leg was scratched by poison ivy and he needs an antidote!"
…
The shouts and the groans of the injured were mixed together.
Not far away, several soldiers wearing standard armor looked on coldly with their arms folded.
Lin Mo walked straight out of the city without stopping, going against the flow of people.
His actions immediately attracted a lot of attention.
"Huh? Going out of the city alone in the middle of the night?"
"Look at his aura, it's not even level 10, right? Are you looking for death?"
"This kind of rookie is probably going crazy because of his poverty. Is there any chance we can see him again tomorrow?"
"Goodbye? You mean he turned into wild dog shit, hahaha"
…
The discussion reached his ears, but Lin Mo turned a deaf ear.
There was no pause in his footsteps.
However, he had just stepped out of the city gate.
A figure suddenly jumped out from the side and stopped in front of him.
This man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, wearing an ill-fitting leather armor, approached with a flattering smile on his face: "Hey, this little brother, he looks very strange. Going out of the city alone in the middle of the night? Do you want a map? The precise terrain outside the forest has marked the distribution points of low-level monsters and several safe water sources. For only 10 gold coins, you can be a fool!"
Lin Mo frowned.
He does need the map, but 10 gold coins are equivalent to more than half of his existing funds.
The price is a steal.
He refused coldly: "No need."
As soon as Lin Mo finished speaking, the smile on the man's face disappeared instantly.
Became somber and serious.
He took a step forward and lowered his voice: "Little brother, I think... you need it."
Lin Mo's eyes narrowed: "What do you mean?"
The movement here also attracted the attention of other adventurers in the open space, and whispers came: "It's Layton, he's trying to trick the rookie again."
"This kid is unlucky. He was targeted by Layton. He will have to shed his skin even if he doesn't die."
"Yeah, when I first came here, I was robbed too, damn..."
"Shh, keep your voice down and don't get into trouble."
…
Listening to the discussions around him, Lin Mo understood.
He narrowed his eyes and looked at Layton: "Robbery at the city gate? Aren't you afraid of those guards?"
He motioned to the soldiers not far away with his eyes.
Layton sneered, as if he heard a big joke, and pointed to his feet: "Idiot, look clearly, this is already outside the city! Even if I kill you here, the guards will only come here to collect your body, and they have nothing to do with me getting rich!"
Lin Mo nodded, with no expression on his face. He just clenched the black sword in his hand.
"I see, outside the city... you are not protected, then I understand."
Seeing that he had surrendered, Leighton raised his chin proudly: "Now that you understand, don't wait any longer and get the money quickly..."
